article.title: When You Vote Blue
article.author: Johnny Townsend
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. The cheerleaders for Team Blue insist we vote for every Democrat in every race across the country, without exception. Don’t let the perfect be the enemy of the good. No litmus tests. No purity tests. Vote Blue, even if the candidate takes corporate money, wants more training for ICE agents, opposes trans rights, and backs genocide. If you’re a Palestinian, or Muslim, or trans, or have family with green cards who could be kidnapped and deported to a prison halfway around the world, just suck it up and vote blue anyway. Because “democracy is at stake!” But if we vote for these corporate, anti-trans, xenophobic, pro-genocide candidates, democracy will still be under attack. Saying “but at least they’re Democrats” is like saying only rape by a stranger is bad, that we should tolerate sexual assault and keep our mouths shut when it’s perpetrated by a family member. A brief thought experiment shows why voting blue no matter who won’t work. Imagine a new DNC ad: “The nation is polarized, with women, people of color, religious minorities, and LGBTQ folks feeling victimized. Our new Democratic Party platform to address this instability is to disenfranchise all white men for a set period of ten years, at which point full rights will be automatically restored. White men won’t be able to vote during the next ten years, and we can’t guarantee temporary laws won’t be passed making it harder for them to rent an apartment, limit their healthcare, or have protections in the workplace. But remember, it’s only for ten years. And it’s for the greater good. Don’t be a crybaby. Take one for the team. Help unify the country and fight fascism!” Related: Who Should Pay for Infrastructure? How many white men would vote blue no matter who under those conditions? Yet what “centrists” demand is even more extreme. Of course, the problem with this thought experiment is that no straight, white cis man is remotely capable of truly imagining a life without full rights. The scenario is too far removed from their lived experience. Even cis white gay men have so much privilege, despite homophobia and general difficulties under capitalism, to comprehend what it would be like to vote for a Democrat campaigning on promises to supply bombs to destroy every gay bar in America, every gay bookstore and community center, and the home of every gay man. Still, these “pragmatic,” corporate Dems demand that we support anti-trans “allies,” candidates who refuse to eliminate ICE, candidates who claim that stopping a genocide is a bad thing. We must vote blue, no matter who. It matters. Denying rights to anyone threatens the rights of everyone. Excusing injustice and the slaughter of innocents is never going to save democracy. A person who supports genocide is not pro-democracy. By definition. The way to win support—and the way to govern—requires bold policies guaranteeing equality, justice, fairness…and improvement in our lives. Asking voters to sacrifice their rights or the rights and lives of others isn’t only immoral, it’s also ineffective. Whether or not such a strategy should win, the truth is at this point, it can’t . In the past, more voters could be gaslit. Today, we’ve seen too much to believe the lies promoting either economic austerity or rationing human rights. Voters aren’t demanding candidates pass a purity test. But we do have minimum requirements. Purity would include universal healthcare, subsidized childcare, tuition-free college and trade school, fare-free public transit, Universal Basic Income, and more. Related: Democrats Are Taking—and Failing—the Wrong Test Considering all human beings as human is the minimum. Being polished and articulate isn’t enough. Cory Booker and Pete Buttigieg consistently put corporations and big donors ahead of constituents. Chuck Schumer and Gavin Newsom, too. And didn’t we elect Democrats John Fetterman and Kyrsten Sinema into office? Yay for Team Blue! Like it or not, winning requires a coalition, and when you explain up front that you consider some people to be less human than others, you’re going to lose a critical mass of voters. As you should. Democracy is at stake. So only vote for Democrats, Independents, Green Party candidates, and Socialists who champion the rights of all people.
